SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.
We’re not just building another investment service - we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
The Role 
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and coach a cross-functional team of 6–8 engineers across frontend, backend, and AI/ML. Your focus will be on building a high-trust, accountable environment where engineers take ownership of their work and grow their skills, while also contributing to technical initiatives and ensuring reliable delivery.
You’ll balance people leadership with hands-on engagement, guiding outcomes and helping individuals grow.
Your Mission
Partner with your Product Manager to plan, scope, and deliver roadmap goals that drive customer and business impact.

Own selected technical projects, often with suppliers or partners, ensuring smooth execution from requirements to rollout.

Build a healthy, high-trust team by setting clear expectations, coaching individuals, and empowering engineers to take ownership of their growth and delivery.

Raise the team’s competence and practices by championing effective rituals, continuous learning, and strong communication.

Ensure system health and reliability through meaningful monitoring, observability, and post-mortem learning.

Promote engineering excellence by driving quality, CI/CD, and operational readiness before launch.

Act as a facilitator-leader - guiding trade-offs, unblocking decisions, and creating space for experts to excel.

Continuously improve how the team works by introducing better ways of working and helping the org adopt them.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Co-own backlog, scope, and planning with the Product Manager.

Run effective execution rituals (standups, planning, reviews) with transparent risk management.

Lead feedback conversations, performance reviews, and growth plans.

Partner with the Tech Lead on architecture decisions and technical strategy; contribute code when it’s high leverage.

Coordinate work with suppliers/partners and manage integrations.

Oversee access management, compliance, and KPI/observability work.

Lead by example and contribute to the codebase, such as solving bugs or deliver on features.

Additionally, You Will
Promote good engineering practices and constructive code reviews.

Foster a learning culture that values feedback and continuous skill development.

Influence platform roadmap and tech stack evolution.

Balance short-term delivery with long-term sustainability and simplicity.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You…
Multiple years of experience from software engineering. 

Have experience leading cross-functional engineering teams in a product environment.

Can balance hands-on technical contribution with people leadership.

Are motivated by coaching, developing others, and raising the competence of your team.

Care deeply about reliable systems, observability, and safe, compliant delivery.

Demonstrate accountability, empathy, and a growth mindset.

Communicate clearly in English and/or Swedish.

Are eligible to work in Sweden (Swedish citizen or EU work permit) - we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Our Cultural DNA
At SAVR, we’re:
🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning
🚀 Bold – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward
🤝 Honest – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing
We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in. 
What’s In It for You
You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.
Here’s what we offer:
💻 Top-tier work gear
💰 Competitive salary
🏃‍♀️ Generous wellness allowance
🤒 Insurance package
🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support
🏢 Office-first approach to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)
🥗 Stocked pantry, plus regular social gatherings and wellness activities to keep energy and culture high
Our Commitment to Diversity
SAVR is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
Ready to Join Us?
We’d love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out with any questions — and let’s build something meaningful together.

Lyten is leading an industrial revolution through Lyten 3D Graphene™, a breakthrough supermaterial unlocking a new generation of products — from lithium–sulfur batteries and energy storage systems to concrete admixtures, lightweight composites, and next-generation sensors that are revolutionizing industries. Together, these innovations are making a massive global improvement and driving real-world impact across energy, mobility, construction, and defense.
At Lyten, we believe the most meaningful careers begin with purpose — and with people who want to make a difference. We’re not just developing advanced supermaterials — we’re about to change the world as we know it, reshaping how energy is stored, how products are built, and how progress is made.
We’re entering an exciting growth phase, scaling production across the U.S. and Europe and expanding our team of engineers, scientists, and innovators.
Apply now to join our team and be part of something bigger than yourself — where collaboration, creativity, and purpose come together to build the technologies that will define the next century.
Job Scope 

Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 

The Automation Engineer (Logistics) is responsible for overall project management related to industrial material flow engineering projects for Lyten’s advanced factories and warehouses, including design and implementation of new technologies and specialized equipment. 
This role drives the development, integration, and continuous improvement of automated materialflow solutions that enable safe, efficient, and scalable operations across Lyten’s advanced factories and warehouses. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Responsible for managing projects, timelines, track progress on projects focusing on material flow and material handling engineering.  
Responsible for design and implementation of automation systems for internal material flows for advanced factories and warehouses including:  
Design and implementation of new technologies for specialized equipment.  
Identification, evaluation and interact with key vendors. 
Responsible for coordinating engineers, project leaders and vendors to design material flow solutions. 
Ramping up the equipment to expected efficiency through manual and semi-automatic phases. 
Troubleshooting, analysing and reporting problems with equipment. Driving the necessary improvements continuously. 
Responsible for defining and contributing to following cross functional Blueprint areas, where Blueprint is referring to a lean, standardized and a flexible enough solution for a designated factory block to easily be adopted and scaled. 
Material Handling Blueprint. 
Material Flow Blueprint. 
Engineering Tools and Methods Blueprint. 
Responsible to secure and enable cross functional collaboration to Lyten Digital business unit and Factory Automation team to define technical interfaces for advanced real time monitoring, control, and optimization. 
Responsible for collaboration and interaction with Lyten final customers regarding design and implementation of material handling engineering projects. 
Contribute to profitability through efficiency improvements and cost optimization projects. 

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No 
Direct reports: No 
Work Environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace.

Education and Qualification 
Degree in Mechanical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Engineering or similar.  
Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, or automation systems related to material flow (low to medium voltage system, variable frequency drives system and conveyor technology). 
Excellent stakeholder and supplier management. 
Experience within Industrial Automation or Automated PLC Based Systems (ASRS, AGV) and configuration of PLC, SCADA, WINCC, OPC connectivity and MES interfaces, especially using Siemens. 
Experience in writing technical documentation (Requirement specifications, Functional design, Test Cases, Test Records).  

Specific skills & Knowledge  
Safety-oriented mindset, familiar with LoTo procedures, permits-to-work, and industrial safety standards. 
Problem-solving skills with ability to work both independently and in a team. 
Strong computer literacy (CMMS and MS Office) with the ability to document work in English.  
Hands-on, practical, and structured approach to daily tasks. 
High sense of responsibility and reliability. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.   
Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking safer and smarter ways of working. 

Health, Safety & Environmental responsibility  
Follow company policies and procedures. 
Use PPE according to safety rules. 
Report hazards and incidents.

Represent the Plants discipline in customer meetings, partner discussions, and technical reviews.

Job Description

WHAT YOU’LL DO​
As a Sales Advisor at H&M, you’ll play a key role in creating an outstanding customer experience. You’ll welcome customers, guide them through your store, and support them in finding what they need while showcasing our products. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.
You will:
Share your fashion and product knowledge to help customers make informed choices.
Collaborate with your team to deliver exceptional service at every step of the customer journey.
Ensure the sales floor and back of house are well-stocked, organized, and inviting.
Support with opening and closing of the store.
Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​
Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.
WHO YOU ARE​
We are looking for people with…​
Experience in customer service within fashion, retail, or similar fields.

And people who are…​
Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in-store experience while promoting our products and driving sales.
Thriving in collaborative and dynamic environments.
Communicative, creative, curious to work with store technology, with a strong eagerness to learn and develop.
Flexible and action oriented.

WHO WE ARE​
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​
 All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. 
In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 

JOIN US​
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
This is a temporary on-demand position with no guaranteed hours. Work will be offered based on business needs with a start in December or by agreement. We are currently looking for people to our store located in Hässleholm and you should be available to work during store opening hours. Language skills in Swedish or English are required.
We have an ongoing selection, so the position may be filled before the application deadline, so send in your application today! The last application date is 25/11.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​
 
* Store roles assessment: 
To manage the high volume of applications for the Sales Advisor role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment within some of our stores. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group. Please look out for an email in your inbox/junk email from MAKI. 
After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact on your application. 
For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice. 
** We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

We are looking for a dedicated Imaging Engineer to strengthen our team! In this role you will further develop the imaging platform for our production systems but also support industrialization and R&D to turn new products and ideas into mass production. Does this sound interesting? Keep reading and welcome with your application!

Who is your future team?
You will join the Imaging team, a specialized group of four experienced engineers focused on developing the imaging parts needed within our production systems to produce Axis cameras with high image quality.

These production systems play a critical role in supporting high-volume manufacturing operations at our global facilities, where millions of products are produced and tested annually.

The Imaging team is part of a larger division of about 60+ engineers working with Production Engineering and Technology (PET), and together with our colleagues within SW, electronics and mechanical engineering we develop and maintain production systems globally.

What you'll do here as Imaging Engineer
As an Imaging Engineer, you'll contribute to the design, development and maintenance of imaging production tests that enable the testing of Axis products in our production systems. You will also be a part of our development projects where we use innovative imaging and optical solutions to design efficient and reliable production systems.
Typical tasks include handling topics related to optics, collimators and other imaging equipment needed to produce Axis' products.
You will also play an important role in designing, developing, and maintaining software frameworks used for verification and calibration of our production systems. This includes collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless production processes.
Key responsibilities include:
Designing and maintaining both SW and HW for the imaging tests framework to support production processes.
Developing and maintaining software frameworks to facilitate machine monitoring, verification, calibration and production testing using C# and Python
Providing technical support to R&D product development initiatives
Analyzing production data to drive system improvements and innovation
Contributing to strategic planning for future imaging test development

Our team leverages a range of technologies, including:
Hardware like different types of optics and collimators
Programming languages: C#, Python, C++
Tools: Jira, Confluence, QlikView, Visual Studio, GitHub Copilot
Version control systems: Git, SVN, Gerrit
Continuous integration platforms: TeamCity
Agile methodologies

Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We think you are a dedicated engineer with skills in imaging, optics and software development who is curious, responsible, organized and methodical. You enjoy problem solving and working with both hardware and software. Ability to communicate is important as the role requires collaboration with other teams and departments. The work includes a lot of freedom and independence, which requires that you are proactive and take initiative.
We'd love to hear that you have:
Experience within optics, collimators or other imaging equipment
A huge interest in software development and optics
Finding solutions to complex technical problems
Interest in the complexity of production and creating efficient production systems for our factories around the world
University degree preferably within computer science, engineering, physics, electrical engineering or equivalent
At least a couple of years of experience from roles in a development organization
Good communication skills in English and Swedish, both in speech and writing

The position is full time. Travelling is not required, but there will probably be possibilities to visit our factories around the world.

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. 
Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.
As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. 
Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

Company Description

Bosch Home Comfort in Tranås develops, manufactures and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources: rock, water and air. Our Tranås site brings together manufacturing, research and development, and business functions, creating an environment where ideas and decisions are closely connected to our products and operations.
We believe in technology that makes a difference: Invented for life.
 

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Do you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers?
As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing, partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions.
You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance.
Your key responsibilities
Business partnering: Act as a financial partner to Plant Management and cost center owners. Provide analysis, challenge assumptions and translate financial performance into clear insights and actions.
Planning & forecasting: Drive key parts of our business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, including cost centers, Capex, production volumes, headcount and product costs.
Manufacturing performance: Analyze manufacturing costs, productivity and operational deviations. Work with the organization to understand root causes and identify appropriate countermeasures.
Product costing: Lead Planned Product Cost (PPC) calculations, follow Actual Product Costs (APC) and analyze the operational and financial drivers behind deviations.
Investments, assets & inventory: Support investment planning and follow-up, fixed asset management, inventory valuation, physical stocktaking and continuous inventory control.
Reporting & continuous improvement: Drive monthly and annual plant performance reporting while continuously improving our processes, reporting, dashboards and use of SAP and other digital tools.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you
You have a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a comparable field, together with experience in controlling, financial analysis or a related finance role.
Experience from manufacturing or another industrial environment is particularly valuable.
We are looking for someone with:
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and operational data
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting or operational reporting
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel
Experience working with ERP systems. SAP experience, particularly within controlling or manufacturing processes, is an advantage
Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirement

Experience with product costing, Power BI, automation or other data-analysis tools is an advantage, but you do not need to tick every box. We value your ability to learn, understand the business and turn data into meaningful insights.
Who you are
You are curious about the business behind the numbers. When you see a deviation, your instinct is not simply to report it. You want to understand why it happened, what is driving it and what we can do about it.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating across functions to find solutions. You can explain financial concepts clearly to colleagues outside Finance and combine strong analytical thinking with a practical mindset.
You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships and are motivated by understanding how a manufacturing business works and how Finance can help make it better.

Additional Information

Why join us in Tranås?
In Tranås, more than 600 associates work across manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a more sustainable future.
For a Plant Controller, this creates an exciting environment where you can see the connection between the numbers, the decisions and what actually happens in the factory.
The role gives you broad exposure to manufacturing finance, product costing, investments and operational performance, while working within the international Bosch organization. It is an opportunity to deepen your controlling expertise, influence the business and continue developing your career.
At Bosch, we value openness, trust and different perspectives, and we want our associates to have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.
What we offer
Competitive compensation
Pension, insurance and other benefits in accordance with our collective agreement
Flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities where compatible with the role
Employee discounts on Bosch products
Development opportunities within an international Bosch organization

Regular presence at our Tranås site is an important part of the role because of the close collaboration with our manufacturing organization.
If you enjoy combining finance, manufacturing and problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.
